desc: Orlivane mini letter openers have a 420J stainless steel blade hidden in a narrow slot. Slide one along an envelope, package tape or wrapping paper to open or cut it. Each opener is about 8 x 5.5 cm, and the set of six in soft colors weighs about 45 g. Keep away from children.
b: HIDDEN BLADE — A 420J stainless steel blade sits inside a narrow slot, so only the edge of the paper or tape touches it.
SLIDE TO OPEN — Slide it along an envelope, package tape or a roll of wrapping paper for a clean cut.
6 SOFT COLORS — Six openers in muted pastel colors, one for the desk, kitchen drawer, gift wrap station and more.
POCKET SIZE — About 8 x 5.5 cm (3.1 x 2.2 in); the set of six weighs about 45 g.
NO LOGO — Plain design with no printing, good for the office, home or a small gift.
kw: letter opener mini wrapping paper cutter envelope opener package opener box cutter tape cutter pastel office desk accessories
